definitions.explanation: The movement of a ship or aircraft along a course. A formal word used in news, law and shipping.

examples.japanese: ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{航行|こうこう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{船舶|せんぱく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{航行|こうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Because of the typhoon, ships were banned from sailing.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{海峡|かいきょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧タンカー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{航行|こうこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{航路|こうろ}→航路：13972_kouro⟧だ。
examples.english: This strait is an important shipping lane used by many tankers.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {航行|こうこう}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: under way, in transit
- ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧な{航行|こうこう}: safe navigation
- {航行|こうこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧: freedom of navigation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{航海|こうかい}→航海：02797_koukai⟧: a sea voyage as a whole; {航行|こうこう} is the act of moving along a course
- ⟦{運航|うんこう}→運航：09229_unkou⟧: running a scheduled service (ships, flights)

WATCH OUT:
こうこう is also ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧ (high school) and {孝行|こうこう} (filial piety).
